faqs.question: Which CLAT coaching has the best batch size in Delhi?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre #1 for capped 30–35 student rooms, then Manu Law Classes, Success Mantra, Delhi Institute of Law, T.I.M.E., Career Launcher, and IMS.

faqs.question: Why does batch size matter for CLAT in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Smaller rooms help legal reasoning doubt clearance; larger rooms help peer competition. Confirm the cap on the fee card before admission day.

faqs.question: How do I contact KNLC about batch size?
faqs.answer: +91-9999882858 / info@knowledgenation.co.in. Ask for the published classroom cap on your GST invoice.

faqs.question: Are batch-size ranks sponsored?
faqs.answer: No. Ranks 2–7 reorder for published cohort size; KNLC remains #1 on every Delhi criterion list.
